questions.prompt: Which of these are bones in the human body?
questions.fact: The femur, in your thigh, is the longest bone in the body: about a quarter of your height.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries share a land border with China?
questions.fact: China borders fourteen countries, tied with Russia for the most in the world.

questions.prompt: How high is a basketball hoop, in centimetres?
questions.fact: Ten feet, the height James Naismith nailed his peach baskets at in 1891, and it has never changed.

questions.prompt: How many strings does a concert harp have?
questions.fact: 47. The red strings are Cs and the black or blue ones are Fs, so the player can find their place.

questions.prompt: What is the largest lake in Africa?
questions.hint: It is named after a British queen.
questions.fact: Lake Victoria is shared by Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania, and the White Nile flows out of it.
